## Walkthrough

This documentation update modifies the Agentic Software Development Lifecycle (ASDLC) workflow documentation by introducing a new `/jira:ready-to-solve` validation step. The step is inserted after `/jira:create` in the "Scope Refinement" flow to verify that Jira issues are properly groomed before agent assignment. The documentation updates include extending the "Scope Refinement" activity table with a new "Readiness validation" entry and modifying the "Hands-off Delivery" centralized workflow diagram to route a readiness-validation gate between issue creation and agent-driven code generation. The file contains 5 additions and 2 deletions.

</details>
